items.headline: It's Dodgers vs. Brewers — the NL pennant matchup is locked in
items.body: Both National League series ended on the same night. The Dodgers finished off the Braves 3-1 to win their series in four, and the top-seeded Brewers closed out the Padres — young star Jackson Chourio drove in a run in all four games. That sets up a juicy NLCS: L.A.'s star-studded, deep-pocketed lineup against Milwaukee's scrappy, homegrown No. 1 seed. Winner goes to the World Series.
items.say: The baseball final four is basically set — it's the Dodgers against the Brewers for the National League pennant. Big-money L.A. versus the little-market team that won the most games all year. Love that contrast. You following any October baseball, or just the highlights?

items.headline: Rays finish the job — Yankees swept out of October
items.body: Tampa Bay never let up. After stealing the first two games, the Rays finished a three-game sweep of the Yankees — the first ALDS sweep in franchise history — and sent New York home early yet again. The small-payroll club now moves on to the American League Championship Series. For the Bronx, it's another big-budget season that ends way sooner than anyone planned.
items.say: The Rays just swept the Yankees right out of the playoffs — the little team with the tiny budget bounced the big bad Yankees in three straight. That never gets old. You got a team still alive, or just here for the drama?

items.headline: White Sox go for the clincher tonight — one win from the ALCS
items.body: The feel-good story of October gets another shot tonight. The upstart White Sox lead the favored Guardians 2-1 and host Game 4 in Chicago (8 p.m. ET). Cleveland staved off elimination with a Game 3 blowout, so the Sox have to finish it the hard way — but a win sends this young, out-of-nowhere roster to its first League Championship Series since the 2005 title team. Lose, and it's a winner-take-all Game 5.
items.say: The White Sox can clinch a trip to the final four tonight — this team was historically awful a couple years ago and now they're one win from their deepest run since 2005. Nothing like a close-out game. You catching any of it, or just the highlights?

items.headline: Bucs at Cowboys kick off Week 5 under the lights in Dallas
items.body: Football's back on a Thursday: Tampa Bay heads to AT&T Stadium to face the Cowboys tonight (8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video) to open Week 5. It's a classic made-for-primetime matchup — the Bucs' offense against Dak Prescott and that loud Dallas crowd under the big screen. Perfect excuse to get the wings going on a weeknight.
items.say: There's a Cowboys game on tonight — Thursday night football, Bucs in Dallas. Good excuse to order wings on a weeknight. You riding with anybody this NFL season, or just here for the primetime games?

items.headline: Texas-OU at the Cotton Bowl — college football's wildest party is Saturday
items.body: One of the best scenes in all of sports returns Saturday: Texas vs. Oklahoma, the Red River Rivalry, right in the middle of the Texas State Fair in Dallas (2:30 p.m. CT, ABC/ESPN). The Cotton Bowl gets split straight down the middle — burnt orange on one side, crimson on the other — with a giant corny dog and a Ferris wheel in the background. Bragging rights, playoff stakes, and absolute bedlam.
items.say: The Texas-Oklahoma game is Saturday — that's the one at the state fair where they split the stadium right down the middle, half orange and half red. One of the coolest atmospheres in all of sports. You follow any college ball on Saturdays?

items.headline: DC goes full horror — the 'Clayface' trailer is pure body-horror nightmare fuel
items.body: Spooky season is bleeding into the comic-book world: 'Clayface,' the first R-rated horror movie in the new DC Universe, hits theaters Oct 23, and the trailer is genuinely unsettling. It follows a rising Hollywood actor whose face is wrecked in a brutal attack — and whose body starts shape-shifting out of control. Horror ace Mike Flanagan ('The Haunting of Hill House') co-wrote it, and it leans all the way into the gross-out scares.
items.say: DC made a straight-up horror movie — 'Clayface,' the Batman villain, and the trailer is nasty in the best way. Out in a couple weeks, right in time for Halloween. You into the creepy stuff this time of year, or does it just stress you out?

items.headline: Florence Pugh goes deliciously evil in Netflix's 'East of Eden'
items.body: If you need a prestige binge, Netflix's new seven-part take on Steinbeck's 'East of Eden' is the one people are talking about. Florence Pugh is magnetic as Cathy Ames, one of literature's great villains, in a sweeping family saga of fathers, sons and betrayal. The reviews single out Pugh, and the trailer's chilling line — 'evil is not always apparent at first glance' — tells you the tone. It's streaming now.
items.say: There's a new Netflix show, 'East of Eden,' with Florence Pugh playing basically a beautiful villain — it's that classic American novel. Looks like a proper curl-up-on-the-couch fall binge. You need a new show, or already got one going?

items.headline: Vision is back — Marvel's 'VisionQuest' lands next week
items.body: Marvel fans, mark it down: 'VisionQuest' premieres on Disney+ Oct 14, bringing Paul Bettany's Vision back as he pieces together who he really is — and runs into a certain old villain, Ultron, along the way. It's an eight-episode continuation of the 'WandaVision' story, and the trailer that dropped at D23 got the fandom buzzing. A nice fall watch even if you only half-follow the Marvel stuff.
items.say: Marvel's bringing back Vision — the red robot guy from WandaVision — in a new show next week. Looks like it's got Ultron back too. You keep up with any of the Marvel shows, or did you tap out a while ago?

items.headline: Olivia Rodrigo's 'Unraveled Tour' is tearing across the country right now
items.body: If there's a teenager (or a parent of one) in your life, you've heard about this: Olivia Rodrigo's massive 'Unraveled Tour' — 65 dates behind her chart-topping album — is rolling through North America this fall. Her lead single 'drop dead' debuted at No. 1 and its video, filmed inside the palace at Versailles, is a whole gorgeous event. Multi-night stops are selling out everywhere.
items.say: Olivia Rodrigo's on this huge tour right now — tickets are impossible to get. Even the music video for her latest song is filmed inside a French palace. You keep up with the new pop stuff, or is that firmly the kids' department?

items.headline: Sheryl Crow's back — new album 'Pick You Up' drops Friday
items.body: A treat for the grown-up radio crowd: Sheryl Crow releases 'Pick You Up,' her 13th studio album, this Friday (Oct 9). The breezy, rootsy single 'Freight Train' sets the tone — exactly the warm, windows-down sound she's been doing for 30 years. A Rock & Roll Hall of Famer who still sounds like a Sunday afternoon.
items.say: Sheryl Crow's got a new album out Friday — still that easy, sunny, windows-down sound after all these years. Kind of comforting she's still at it. You have an artist you grew up on that you always come back to?
